critical_code_review_comments: ProductPreviewLoop.js (255 lines) — well-structured, sub-components extracted (ChatPreview, ScorePreview, VideoPreview). RAF cleanup on unmount is correct. setInterval cleanup correct.

Minor: ScorePreview's score animation runs on mount only — on re-mount (when tab is re-selected) it resets to 73 and animates again, which is correct behaviour. requestAnimationFrame eased curve (cubic) is smooth.
Minor: VideoPreview embeds an Unsplash background image URL — if Unsplash CDN is down, only the gradient backdrop shows. Not a defect but worth noting as a single external dependency.

Minor: <style> tags are inlined inside two sub-components (VideoPreview's micBar/sexierPop + outer previewProgress). Works but two <style> tags get re-mounted on every state cycle for VideoPreview. Could be hoisted to global CSS for one-time injection. Cosmetic perf only.
Mode-switch CTA uses lime gradient border on default — visually meets premium spec. Hover transition is smooth. ArrowRight icon translates 2px on hover. Good UX.
